AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%') AND b.trade_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY m.member_id, m.member_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(b.trade_time, '%Y') AS name, DATE_FORMAT(b.trade_time, '%Y-%m') AS name,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bill_type = 2 THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bill_type = 1 THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM fortune_bill b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.include = TRUE AND b.bill_type IN (1, 2)
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%') AND b.trade_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY name ORDER BY name ASC

AND b.title LIKE '%' || #{query.title} || '%' AND b.trade_time <= #{query.endDate} || ' 23:59:59' GROUP BY name ORDER BY name ASC

AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%') GROUP BY DATE(b.trade_time) ORDER BY date ASC

WITH account_amount AS ( SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_name AS accountName, a.account_type AS accountType, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS amount FROM fortune_bill b INNER JOIN fortune_account a ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.include = TRUE AND b.bill_type = #{query.billType}
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%') AND b.trade_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_type ), total AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM account_amount) SELECT accountId, accountName, accountType, amount, CASE WHEN (SELECT total_amount FROM total) IS NULL OR (SELECT total_amount FROM total) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE amount / (SELECT total_amount FROM total) * 100 END AS percent FROM account_amount ORDER BY amount DESC

WITH account_amount AS ( SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_name AS accountName, a.account_type AS accountType, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS amount FROM fortune_bill b INNER JOIN fortune_account a ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.include = 1 AND b.bill_type = #{query.billType}
AND b.title LIKE '%' || #{query.title} || '%' AND b.trade_time <= #{query.endDate} || ' 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_type ), total AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM account_amount) SELECT accountId, accountName, accountType, amount, CASE WHEN (SELECT total_amount FROM total) IS NULL OR (SELECT total_amount FROM total) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(amount AS REAL) / (SELECT total_amount FROM total) * 100 END AS percent FROM account_amount ORDER BY amount DESC

AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%') AND b.trade_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY b.bill_type ), total AS (SELECT SUM(value) AS total_amount FROM type_amount) SELECT billType, value, CASE WHEN (SELECT total_amount FROM total) IS NULL OR (SELECT total_amount FROM total) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value / (SELECT total_amount FROM total) * 100 END AS percent FROM type_amount ORDER BY billType ASC

SELECT COALESCE(p.payee_name, '未设置交易对象') AS payeeName, SUM(CASE WHEN b.bill_type = 9 THEN b.amount WHEN b.bill_type = 10 THEN -b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount, MAX(b.trade_time) AS lastTradeTime FROM fortune_bill b LEFT JOIN fortune_payee p ON b.payee_id = p.payee_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.include = TRUE AND b.book_id = #{bookId} AND b.bill_type IN (9, 10) GROUP BY b.payee_id, p.payee_name HAVING amount > 0 ORDER BY amount DESC
